title: Takaichi: Japan to partner with Asean in addressing AI vulnerabilities

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Japan will partner with Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member states in ensuring that vulnerabilities brought by artificial intelligence (AI) to different sectors of society will be addressed, Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae said on Tuesday. During the 29th Asean-Japan summit held at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC), Takaichi said that they have launched the Japan-Asean AI Safety and Security Partnership so that they can explore solutions with member states affected by AI vulnerabilities.
